reviewed_scope.archive_screen_limit: Schemas, accession rows, workbook cells and metadata-term text screening; not a full scientific review of every figure. No source-author code, HTML scripts, workbook formulas or additional figure computations executed.

scientific_limits: Run, experiment, sample, BioSample and library labels establish archive joins; neither shared nor distinct labels determine independent biological units or physical preparation ancestry.
SRA Pool/Member associations and paper-level equimolar sequencing-library pooling do not supply target physical shared-pool membership.
Two V4/300-mg candidates are absent from Figure 2D. Their exact processed standard reads and accession-specific exclusion decisions remain unverified.
Twenty-four released condition-label records are not the complete attempted biological-sample denominator; no missing zero observations, detection probability or invisible-loss bound is inferred.
Source mass labels do not establish actual weighed mass. Approximate paper-level copy dose does not establish per-run introduced-copy truth or dilution uncertainty.
Post-lysis DNA standards do not measure preceding cell loss, viability, mutation births or lineage establishment.
No effective biological sample size, new fit, native transfer, new theorem, qualified external validation or resolution of the 44 native fields follows.
rights_and_privacy: Public payloads contain selected public identifiers and original synthesis/code; raw XML contacts/postal details, original archive data/code, private paths and credentials remain outside Git. Original prose/joins CC BY 4.0 and original code MIT do not relicense NCBI or other third-party sources or grant patent-use permission.
verification_semantics: Final package membership/checksum closure and producer full replay are verified separately after their receipt files are finalized. Public-only integrity verification must continue to label external-source replay UNRUN.
